cadence.execution: explicit consumer-owned invocation; no scheduler installed

freshness.incomplete_inventory: cannot establish absence or passing freshness
freshness.unknown_roles: retain unknown; public identity admission remains independent

retention.baseline: explicit compatible public checkpoint artifact and digest
retention.failed_collection: cannot replace the last valid baseline

audit_contract.composition: Use the owner's read-only request, evidence, finding, report-status and immutable-output contract. This profile adds applicability and cadence; it does not copy or replace the audit protocol.

checkpoint_sections: public catalog drift and inventory freshness
backlog shape with source and observation boundary
conformance adoption with explicit unavailable domains
current exceptions with owner and expiry evidence
positive observations tied to exact source
comparison baseline identity or explicit unavailable
execution, artifact retention and publication as separate facts
new_repository_rules: Discover through an explicit public-only provider request; never publish protected names, counts or placeholders.
Bind canonical full identity to stable provider repository ID and record observation time, default branch and archive state.
Review owner README, architecture, roadmap and metadata before assigning role, plane, lifecycle or next gate; preserve undeclared values as unknown.
Record historical aliases explicitly; aliases cannot shadow a canonical repository or resolve ambiguously.
Update the canonical catalog, context dependency mapping and active boundary references together; preserve dated ADRs and receipts.
Regenerate the public projection from the reviewed catalog and pin its owner schema/helper revision before consumer admission.
Treat new, missing, renamed, transferred, archived or visibility-changed repositories as drift requiring a reviewable source change; discovery never edits the registry.

ownership.hygiene: canonical repository identity, role, applicability, public admission and checkpoint policy
ownership.relay: consumer-owned execution and bounded artifact transport
ownership.repository: source facts, local gates, credentials and final publication

authority.human_approval: never inferred from activity, merge, provider metadata or an audit
